title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. translated_title: WEFT：面向通用智能体的工具使用后训练规模化方法
translated_abstract: 近期在工具使用后训练规模化方面的工作主要集中于可执行环境的合成，然而这只是更广泛的智能体交互系统（包含环境、任务、智能体框架和评估器）中的一个组成部分。孤立地扩展环境并不能保证模型性能获得相应的提升，因为可靠的学习信号依赖于智能体交互系统中所有组件之间的连贯交互。为解决这一问题，我们提出了WEFT（Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training，面向工具使用后训练的全系统演化），该方法将可扩展的智能体交互系统构建、执行驱动的自我演化以及稳定的后训练相结合。WEFT 在环境广度、任务复杂性和交互多样性三个维度上扩展智能体交互系统的构建。执行驱动的自我演化迭代地利用执行轨迹和状态证据来归因失败并修正响应……
tldr: WEFT 提出了一种全系统演化的工具使用后训练框架，通过在环境广度、任务复杂性和交互多样性上协同扩展智能体交互系统，并结合执行驱动的自我演化与稳定后训练，解决了孤立扩展环境无法保证模型性能提升的问题。
en_tdlr: WEFT introduces a whole-system evolution framework for tool-use post-training that scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity, coupling execution-driven self-evolution with stable post-training to solve the problem that scaling environments in isolation does not guarantee model performance gains.
